correctness.rationale: Exact exhaustive canonical coefficient enumeration covers all (5^m-1)/4 scalar classes for m=3,6,10 and every one of the 31 F5 projective points, then computes gradients and exact tangent incidence bitmasks. Verified 31/3906/2441406 cases, respective maxima 6/21/29, no filling cubic. Analytic derivative calculations establish geometric smoothness of cubic and quartic witnesses. Six distinct quartic tangents form a complete pencil through (1:1:0). Two standalone replays passed. No extrapolation beyond F5.
